fragments.new:
for boundary in FamilySyncCommitJournal.Boundary.allCases
            where boundary != .beforeInsightApply && boundary != .afterInsightApply {
            JournalSyncBridge.captureWeakOwner = boundary == .afterGoalsApply
            JournalSyncBridge.lastContext = nil
            JournalSyncBridge.lastContextOperation = "none"
            print("SYNC-MATRIX boundary=\(boundary.rawValue) phase=iteration-enter")
            // Fresh durable state per boundary, journal directory and store file together.

fragments.old:
print("SYNC-MATRIX boundary=\(boundary.rawValue) phase=release-enter")
            oldContainer = container
            journal = nil
            container = nil
fragments.new:
print("SYNC-MATRIX boundary=\(boundary.rawValue) phase=release-enter")
            oldContainer = container
            oldJournal = journal
            journal = nil
            container = nil

fragments.old:
container = nil
            print("SYNC-MATRIX boundary=\(boundary.rawValue) phase=release-return")
            }
            XCTAssertNil(oldContainer, "the prior journal must not retain the old container")
fragments.new:
container = nil
            print("SYNC-MATRIX boundary=\(boundary.rawValue) phase=release-return")
            }
            // Failure-time observation only. No strong owner crosses the assertion.
            if boundary == .afterGoalsApply && oldContainer != nil {
                let journalAlive = oldJournal != nil
                let contextAlive = JournalSyncBridge.lastContext != nil
                let containerAlive = oldContainer != nil
                let containerIdentity = oldContainer.map { String(describing: ObjectIdentifier($0)) } ?? "nil"
                let diagnostic = "SYNC-FAILURE-OWNERS boundary=afterGoalsApply journalAlive=\(journalAlive) contextAlive=\(contextAlive) contextOperation=\(JournalSyncBridge.lastContextOperation) containerAlive=\(containerAlive) containerIdentity=\(containerIdentity) retainPath=unavailable"
                print(diagnostic)
                let attachment = XCTAttachment(string: diagnostic)
                attachment.name = "sync-afterGoalsApply-failure-owners"
                attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
                add(attachment)
            }
            XCTAssertNil(oldContainer, "the prior journal must not retain the old container")
